title: Library panel: add Flash 8 item-preview pane (bitmap/MC/graphic/sound preview above the list)
description: USER-REPORTED MISSING FEATURE. The Library panel lacks the PREVIEW PANE that Flash 8 had. ## Flash 8 behavior A preview box sits ABOVE the library item list (between the panel title bar and the search/column-headers/list). When you click/select a library item, the preview updates: - Bitmap/image -> shows the image. - MovieClip/Graphic -> a rendered preview, with PLAY/STOP controls to preview the animation. - Button -> a preview (up state). - Sound -> a waveform + PLAY/STOP. - Font -> sample text. As you browse/click each item, the preview refreshes for the active item. ## Current gap (confirmed) There is NO preview pane today. LibraryPanel structure (packages/authoring-ui/src/LibraryPanel.tsx): title bar (~line 1093/1094) -> search bar (~1101) -> column headers (~1116) -> item list (~1150) -> bottom toolbar (~1161). Nothing renders a preview of the selected item. Integration point: insert a block immediately after the title bar and BEFORE the search bar (inside the `!collapsed` fragment opened at ~1099), i.e. at the top of the panel above the list. The style scaffolding even hints at this -- the comment at LibraryPanel.tsx:768 already reads "Preview pane / search strip sits above the white item list". SELECTION STATE ALREADY EXISTS: the panel takes `selectedItemId: string | null` + `onItemSelect` props (LibraryPanelProps ~lines 12-13); the preview can key off `selectedItemId` to look up the item in `library.items`. No new selection plumbing needed. ## Available preview sources (concrete impl path) 1. BITMAP -- READILY AVAILABLE. `BitmapItem` (packages/core/src/model/types.ts:403-416) carries `dataUri: string` (e.g. data:image/png;base64,...) plus `originalWidth`/`originalHeight`. Draw directly into an or (the stage renderer renderBitmapObject in packages/core/src/engine/renderer.ts:701-735 reads the same image; CanvasRenderer.loadImage at renderer.ts:1820-1825 loads a dataUri). 2. SYMBOL (movieclip/graphic/button) -- READILY AVAILABLE for a STATIC first-frame preview. Reuse the existing offscreen-render path: `CanvasRenderer` (packages/core/src/engine/renderer.ts:1795, `render(sceneGraph, viewport, library)`), the `snapshotFrame` helper (packages/core/src/engine/snapshot.ts:16-58) already renders a single frame to an offscreen canvas, and Shell.tsx screenshotStage (~3211-3253) is the live example (new CanvasRenderer(offscreen) -> render(sceneGraph, {x:0,y:0,zoom:1}, doc.library) -> toDataURL). Build a minimal SceneGraph from the symbol's timeline first frame (getTweenedFrame, packages/core/src/model/timeline-query.ts:229) and render it. Do NOT duplicate the renderer/screenshotStage math -- reuse it. 3. SOUND -- NEEDS WORK. `SoundItem` (packages/core/src/model/types.ts:418-434) carries `dataUri` (raw mp3/wav bytes as a data URL) + sampleRate/sampleSize/isStereo/durationSeconds, but NOT decoded PCM/AudioBuffer/waveform data.
